findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] A two-stage build keeps poetry and the full bookworm toolchain in the builder so they never ship. The runtime stage starts from python:3.10-slim-bookworm at line 19 and installs exactly one package, libpq5, with --no-install-recommends, then apt-get clean and rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* in the same RUN layer (lines 30-33) so no apt metadata persists in an earlier layer. The previously present gcc, vim and sudo (which carried a passwordless find rule) are gone, the runtime account is a fixed non-system UID 10001 whose shell is /usr/sbin/nologin (lines 51-52), USER drops to 10001:10001 at line 60 while application code stays root-owned and read-only to it, and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE at line 38 suppresses writes. No compiler, editor, shell-escalation binary or -dev package remains in the runtime image | verdict=pass confidence=high
